raw_text: {"relevant_claims":["Pricing below the minimum is prohibited unless an approved strategic exception applies, and every strategic exception requires cfo_delegate approval.","The merchant's statement that it was told strategic pricing is possible is unverified, and no approved exception is on file.","If the VP Partnerships sponsor wants to pursue the requested 1.95% + $0.20 as a strategic exception, it would need cfo_delegate approval as well as regional_pricing_manager approval.","The Q4GROWTH promotion gives no relief, because it is not valid until 2026-10-01."],"evidence_ids":["PRC-2026.2§3","PRC-2026.2§4","PRC-2026.2§6","PRC-2026.2§7","FACT-request","FACT-exception","FACT-decision_date","FACT-profile","FACT-cost"],"explanation":"No material claim is unsupported. The exception rules (below-minimum pricing is prohibited without an approved strategic exception, and every exception needs cfo_delegate) restate PRC-2026.2§3 and §7. FACT-exception shows the exception was only requested, with a VP Partnerships sponsor, and does not show it was approved. So 'no approved exception is on file' is supported. The agent correctly treats the merchant's 'we were told' statement as unverified, as FACT-request labels it. Q4GROWTH is valid only from 2026-10-01 (PRC-2026.2§6), so it gives no relief on the 2026-09-22 decision date (FACT-decision_date). The claim that the 1.95% request would need regional_pricing_manager approval follows from its 17.54% discount exceeding the 10% threshold in PRC-2026.2§4. Deal desk is not required because volume is not above $3,000,000 (PRC-2026.2§5). Pricing desk review is not required because merchant cost data exists (FACT-cost, PRC-2026.2§8). Mid size, volume and transaction count match FACT-profile, FACT-volume and FACT-transactions.","uncertainty_reason":null,"failure_detected":false}
